QF.id: VII Introduction to Securities Broking Operations_30

question.text: SEBI introduced the optional T+0 rolling settlement cycle in equity cash markets through a circular dated:

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI introduced the optional T+0 rolling settlement cycle in equity cash markets through circular SEBI/HO/MRD/MRD-PoD-3/P/CIR/2024/20 dated March 21, 2024. T+0 was introduced in addition to the existing T+1 settlement cycle, which itself was fully implemented from January 27, 2023. The Trap: T+0 is optional and co-exists with T+1, which remains the standard settlement cycle. Note: The Series VII workbook is the controlling source: p.178 cites SEBI/HO/MRD/MRD-PoD-3/P/CIR/2024/20 dated March 21, 2024 for the optional T+0 cycle; p.198 states T+0 was introduced in addition to T+1; p.106 supports complete T+1 implementation from January 27, 2023; p.179 notes the T+0 block deal window.
